# Pip — CHAR_PIP_001

Primary canonical identity for **Doodle Dash Production**.

## Visual source of truth

The operator-supplied PRIMARY_CANONICAL_REFERENCE JPEG defines Pip’s look.

That JPEG is **not** a production Blender model.

## Locked visual DNA (v1)

- Warm golden-yellow soft-feather chick
- Large childlike head; compact pear/egg body
- Distinctive **red** ~3-lobe comb (center tallest)
- Extremely large warm-brown eyes + expressive dark brows
- Small rounded orange beak; orange stylized feet (~3 toes)
- Wing-arms for gesture
- Default accessory: **purple backpack** + gold star charm (`PRESENT` when traveling)

## Forbidden drift

Duck / generic bird / realistic or adult chicken / plastic look / wrong colors / missing comb / missing backpack when canonically present.
